card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

mechanism: A probes the scope, timing and source of party knowledge while avoiding their own whereabouts.
confusable: Unlike ordinary curiosity, questions must replace answers that would reveal A's involvement.
comparison: D06-a tests whether a video was actually seen; D06-b distinguishes observed location from observed action.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
